sections.heading: Equip your Essence
sections.body: Absorbing an Essence adds it to your Soul Archive. Select your First Hunt Essence and equip it in a loadout so it can take part in combat. Slot changes save automatically.

sections.heading: Choose your first equipment
sections.body: After attuning your First Hunt Essence, you receive an Arms Chest and a Fury blueprint. Open the chest in Inventory and choose a one-handed weapon. Open that weapon's equipment panel, select Fury under Blueprints & variants, review the stats, and confirm to consume the blueprint and 100 Cinders. Its base attributes remain intact and Fury adds a bonus on top. Equip your weapon to prepare for Lumo Ruins.

sections.heading: Follow the Quest Journal
sections.body: The journal shows your next objective and where to complete it. Blueprint conversion is optional. Later, dungeons award themed blueprint choices independently of equipment drops, with a choice guaranteed by the fourth completion without one. Check a blueprint in the equipment panel to see its sources and your remaining completions.
